hud.pista: Tap where you want the arrows to fall
hud.murallaCaida: The wall fell! Your allies can't attack this level.

fin.seQueda: You keep the gold you collected.

principal.pista: Tap the field to shoot arrows

fuego.efecto: The wizard's blasts leave the ground burning

arqueros.efecto: An ally who shoots one enemy at a time

inactivo.efecto: While away you earn {a} → {b} of your playing rate

bolsa.efecto: Holds up to {a} h → {b} h while away

critico.efecto: Your arrows: {a} → {b} chance to hit triple

albanil.efecto: Once per level, a battered wall recovers {a} → {b}

autoapuntar.efecto: If you don't tap, your circle drifts toward enemies, slowly: {a} → {b}

ajustes.resumen: In {min} min of play: {partidas} rounds ({ganadas} won), level {desde} → {hasta}, {compras} upgrades bought, +{oro} gold.

mecanicas.esquiva: Walks out of your circle and jumps elsewhere.
mecanicas.aturdido: Stunned after landing: takes double damage.
mecanicas.furia: At half health it rages: everything faster.
mecanicas.embiste: Charges across the field and pants afterwards: takes double damage.
mecanicas.hoz: Hurls its spinning scythe at your wall.
mecanicas.invocaEsqueletos: Summons skeletons that march to the wall.
mecanicas.teletransporte: Teleports in flames (can't be hit meanwhile) and is left recovering: takes double damage.
mecanicas.bolaFuego: Throws fireballs at the wall. Your mage's fire barely hurts it.
mecanicas.rearma: When it falls it reassembles once, with 30% life.
mecanicas.abanico: Throws three daggers in a fan at the wall.
mecanicas.esquivaMucho: Gets out of your circle faster than anyone.
mecanicas.vuelo: Flies high to another spot (your rain of arrows can't hit it in the air) and lands stunned: takes double damage.
mecanicas.llamaradas: Spits five flames across the wall.
mecanicas.escamas: Its steel scales halve the damage until it loses half its life.

verde.texto: Sticky and happy. Fire melts it.

azul.texto: Made of water and wearing a helmet: fire barely hurts it.

rojo.texto: Carries a slingshot and pelts your wall. If the wall falls, your wizard and archers stop attacking.

rey.texto: The first boss, at level 10. Huge, orange and crowned.

goblin.texto: Green and armed with spears: throws them at your wall.

lobo.texto: Super fast and keeps changing direction. Harmless, but hard to hit.

orco.texto: Slow and armored: walks up to the wall and clubs it.

orcoArquero.texto: The toughest on the battlefield: shoots your wall from afar.

loboBlanco.texto: The level 20 boss: huge, white, with a scythe in its jaws.

arana.texto: Spits web at an archer and leaves them tangled (not shooting) for 3 s. Fire burns it easily.

esqueleto.texto: With sword and shield: marches to the wall and hits it. The shield blocks arrows and, when it falls, it reassembles once with half its life.

loboNegro.texto: Comes in packs of 3 and is even faster than the grey one.

bandido.texto: Throws daggers at the wall very often and steps away from your circle: aim at it by hand.

esqueletoMago.texto: The level 30 boss: a skeleton with a wizard hat and a fire staff.

escorpion.texto: Burrows into the sand (can't be hit there) and pops up elsewhere. Its shell resists arrows.

bandidoDesierto.texto: Throws scimitars at the wall and steps away from your circle. Used to the heat, it resists fire.

minotauro.texto: Marches to the wall and, halfway there, charges and hits it hard with its axe.

ciclope.texto: The strongest in the desert: lots of life, and it hurls huge rocks at the wall.

liderBandido.texto: The level 40 boss: red turban, eye patch and two scimitars.

guerreroHierro.texto: Marches in heavy armor: takes half damage until it loses half its life; then the armor falls off and it runs faster.

golem.texto: Slow and hits the wall hard. When it falls it splits into two quick pebbles.

arqueroHierro.texto: Shoots two iron arrows at once at the wall. The iron resists your arrows.

dragoncito.texto: Flies and spits fire at the wall. Your rain of arrows can't reach it: only archers and the mage.

dragonAcero.texto: The level 50 boss: a huge dragon with steel scales.

inactivo.tope: You hit the {h} h cap. Big bag raises it.
inactivo.nuevo: New! You now earn gold even when not playing.
inactivo.explica: Gold per minute while away (up to {h} h)

misiones.gastar: Purple gems buy Relics in the tree.
misiones.nuevo: New! Missions and purple gems (Relics in the tree).

textos.intacta: Win {n} levels without losing the wall
textos.intacta20: Win {n} levels without losing the wall

ranking.guardado: Done! That's how you show up.
ranking.sinConexion: No online ranking here: only your row shows. Play the version published on Claude to compete.
ranking.soloLectura: You can see the ranking, but with this access you don't show up in it.
ranking.nuevo: New! Ranking: compare your level with other players.

pvp.probabilidad: You had a {n}% chance to win
pvp.nuevo: New! PvP Arena: weekly leagues against other players.

tienda.como: Medals: 3 per win, 1 per loss and a prize when the week ends.

guardia.explica: Guard: while you're here, your troops fight a few enemies on their own (20% of what you earn playing).

oleadas.explica: Ever harder waves until your wall falls. Each wave you hold gives Runes to upgrade your gear.
oleadas.nuevo: New! Survival: hold off waves and earn Runes for the Forge.

herreria.como: Each try costs Runes and doesn't always work. If it fails, the next try is likelier. You never lose levels.
